Every refresh must invoke its supplied fetch(key), even while another
refresh is pending. No duplicate suppression, serialization or automatic cancellation.
Each call returns its own exact fetched object or propagates its own exception.
Only the latest-started refresh owns pending and may publish value. Earlier success,
failure or cancellation cannot clear pending while the latest is unresolved.
Latest settlement clears pending even if older calls remain running. Keep the prior
value during loading and on failure/cancellation. Instances are independent.
Synchronous fetch failure also clears its owning pending state. Retry is allowed.

        generation = self.generation
        self.pending = True

            if generation == self.generation:

+import asyncio
+import unittest
+
+from preview import Preview
+
+
+TIMEOUT = 2
+
+
+class ControlledFetch:
+    """Record synchronous invocation and let the test settle the awaitable."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.entered = asyncio.Event()
+        self.result = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
+        self.keys = []
+
+    def __call__(self, key):
+        self.keys.append(key)
+        self.entered.set()
+        return self.result
+
+
+class PreviewTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
+    async def asyncSetUp(self):
+        self.tasks = []
+
+    async def asyncTearDown(self):
+        for task in self.tasks:
+            if not task.done():
+                task.cancel()
+        if self.tasks:
+            await asyncio.wait_for(
+                asyncio.gather(*self.tasks, return_exceptions=True), TIMEOUT
+            )
+
+    def launch(self, preview, key, fetch):
+        task = asyncio.create_task(preview.refresh(key, fetch))
+        self.tasks.append(task)
+        return task
+
+    async def settle(self, task):
+        return await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(task), TIMEOUT)
+
+    async def start(self, preview, key):
+        fetch = ControlledFetch()
+        task = self.launch(preview, key, fetch)
+        await asyncio.wait_for(fetch.entered.wait(), TIMEOUT)
+        self.assertEqual(fetch.keys, [key])
+        self.assertFalse(task.done())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        return task, fetch
+
+    async def seeded(self):
+        preview = Preview()
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIsNone(preview.value)
+        prior = object()
+        task, fetch = await self.start(preview, "seed")
+        fetch.result.set_result(prior)
+        self.assertIs(await self.settle(task), prior)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        return preview, prior
+
+    async def fail_or_cancel(self, task, fetch, cancel):
+        if cancel:
+            task.cancel()
+            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
+                await self.settle(task)
+            self.assertTrue(task.cancelled())
+        else:
+            error = RuntimeError("controlled failure")
+            fetch.result.set_exception(error)
+            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught:
+                await self.settle(task)
+            self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)
+
+    async def retry(self, preview, prior):
+        task, fetch = await self.start(preview, "retry")
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        value = object()
+        fetch.result.set_result(value)
+        self.assertIs(await self.settle(task), value)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)

+                self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+
+    async def test_stale_success_after_latest_failure_or_cancellation(self):
+        for cancel in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(cancel=cancel):
+                preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+                earlier, first = await self.start(preview, "earlier")
+                latest, second = await self.start(preview, "latest")
+                await self.fail_or_cancel(latest, second, cancel)
+                self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+                value = object()
+                first.result.set_result(value)
+                self.assertIs(await self.settle(earlier), value)
+                self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+                self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+                await self.retry(preview, prior)

+    async def test_synchronous_callback_failure_and_retry(self):
+        preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+        earlier, first = await self.start(preview, "earlier")
+        error = ValueError("synchronous failure")
+        keys = []
+
+        def fail(key):
+            keys.append(key)
+            self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+            self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+            raise error

+        task = self.launch(preview, "sync", fail)
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
+            await self.settle(task)
+        self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)
+        self.assertEqual(keys, ["sync"])
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(earlier.done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        await self.retry(preview, prior)
+        published = preview.value
+        stale = object()
+        first.result.set_result(stale)
+        self.assertIs(await self.settle(earlier), stale)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, published)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)

+    async def test_instances_are_independent(self):
+        left, left_prior = await self.seeded()
+        right, right_prior = await self.seeded()
+        old, first = await self.start(left, "left-old")
+        new, second = await self.start(left, "left-new")

+        self.assertFalse(right.pending)
+        self.assertIs(right.value, right_value)
+        self.assertTrue(left.pending)
+        self.assertIs(left.value, left_prior)
+        other_retry, fourth = await self.start(right, "right-retry")
+        second.result.set_result(left_value)
+        self.assertIs(await self.settle(new), left_value)
+        self.assertFalse(left.pending)
+        self.assertIs(left.value, left_value)
+        self.assertTrue(right.pending)
+        self.assertIs(right.value, right_value)
+        self.assertFalse(old.done())
+        await self.fail_or_cancel(old, first, False)
+        self.assertFalse(left.pending)
+        self.assertIs(left.value, left_value)

+        await self.fail_or_cancel(other_retry, fourth, True)
+        self.assertFalse(right.pending)
